title: Aladdin Theater

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Aladdin Theater, known as one of Portland’s best sounding mid-sized venues, is a perfect place for live music, a comedy show, a movie, a play, or a dance recital. We are an intimate space for any live entertainment with great views of the stage from all seats. Our experienced staff has worked at thousands of events and will make sure that your event runs smoothly and professionally. Rental rates for the Aladdin Theater depend on many different factors such as time of day, the day of the week, and the time of year. Most expensive rates are in the spring and fall, on weekends and during the evenings. For rental rates and info please contact
